name: @factstack/ui-remix
description: Primary WebUI for FACTS. Built on Remix 3 — its own VDOM runtime, no React. Vite + JSX via the `remix/component` subpath of the umbrella `remix` package. Two build targets: dev server (live re-analyze) and static (Netlify/Cloudflare deploy, VS Code webview).

scripts.build: vite build && tsx scripts/gen-fb-config.mjs && tsx scripts/generate-discovery.mjs && tsx scripts/inject-data.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
scripts.build:static: vite build --mode static && tsx scripts/gen-fb-config.mjs && tsx scripts/generate-discovery.mjs && tsx scripts/inject-data.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs
scripts.deploy:cf: node scripts/deploy-check.mjs pre && node scripts/carry-history.mjs && pnpm build:static && node scripts/gen-fb-config.mjs --require && node scripts/deploy-check.mjs post && npx --yes wrangler@4.127.1 pages deploy dist --project-name factstack --branch main
